purpose: data-integrity screening only; not class-feature tuning
important_interpretation: High correlation alone does not prove two recordings share the same source.
Low correlation does not prove session independence.
The analysis cannot recover missing session metadata with certainty.
No record is automatically deleted or moved between splits.
Any confirmed overlap across splits requires stopping official evaluation and redesigning the split.

candidate_policy: compare recordings without using model performance
retain top nearest candidates per recording
prioritize cross-split pairs for manual verification
do not treat PSD similarity or feature proximity as proof of copying

metrics: per-channel Pearson correlation after one common lag
forbidden: verification using only one attractive cycle

positive_controls: copy shifted by one common lag across X/Y/Z
shifted copy plus small additive noise
scaled shifted copy plus small noise
negative_controls: two independent three-channel signals with the same fundamental frequency
same-frequency signals with different phases and amplitudes
synthetic_fixture_requirements.goal: demonstrate that the verification logic recognizes known shifted copies without labeling every same-frequency signal as a duplicate

final_claim_boundary: Passing this protocol does not prove absence of every possible leakage or session relationship.
